# ridolfi1646 - transcription v1 of AHNOB OSUNA,C.3456,D.107 pp. 1-5 (Ludovico Ridolfi, Rome, 8 May 1646)
# One line per line of the letter. Groups of 2 digits (letters, syllables) and 3 digits (nomenclator) as written;
# X = the barred sign used as punctuation; a trailing ' = superscript dot over the group; a/b = two possible
# readings of a doubtful group (the first is used by the decryption). Made sign by sign from the PARES images
# (four passes on enlarged strips, 28 Oct 2026) and frozen before any key existed; page 5 was transcribed with
# pages 1-4 but never decoded until the single held-out measurement. "Di Roma li 8 Maggio 1646" is in clear.
# No image is included (fonds of the Archivo Historico de la Nobleza; see NOTES.md).
